shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- routing ---'; sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- app ---'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- main ---'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/charts && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json'); console.log(p.version, JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies))\" && if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md ]; then sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md; else cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md; fi"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/charts@''^1.73.0 && node -e "const p=require('"'./node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json'); console.log(p.version)\" && if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md ]; then sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md; else cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md; printf '\\n--- theming ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md; printf '\\n--- legend ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/legend.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md; printf '\\n--- get started ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md; printf '\\n--- uikit theming tokens relevant ---\\n'; rg -n \"ThemeProvider|theme=|direction|useTheme|--g-color\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs/guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -name theming.md | head; printf '\\n--- theme props ---\\n'; rg -n \"export declare (const|function) ThemeProvider|interface ThemeProviderProps|type Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; printf '\\n--- palette hook candidates ---\\n'; rg -n \"useTheme|theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -60; rg -n "declare.*ThemeProvider|ThemeProviderProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | head -30'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n \"export.*useTheme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30; printf '\\n--- chart colors ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/colors.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- chart Chart d.ts ---\\n'; rg -n \"export.*function Chart|interface ChartProps|type ChartData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '\\n--- config artifacts ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"interface BoxProps|export.*Box|spacing|radius\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Layout/Box/Box.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Layout -g '*.d.ts' | head -60; printf '\\n--- docs layout ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -name 'layout.md' | head; printf '\\n--- chart types line ---\\n'; rg -n \"export interface LineSeries|type ChartSeries|CategoryValue\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; printf '\\n--- box package ---\\n'; rg -n \"export.*const Box|declare.*Box\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*Box*.d.ts' | head -30; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -iname '*box*' -maxdepth 5 | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types -name 'chart.d.ts' -o -name 'base.d.ts'; rg -n \"export interface ChartData|export interface BaseSeriesData|SERIES_TYPE\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -30; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -maxdepth 1 -type f | head -20'
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null | head -20; git diff -- package.json src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,160p'"
